registration_to_flow2d — MATCHREG intensityreg op

• Data kinds: table → flow2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.registration_to_flow2d(result) (to call the implementation directly, import intensityreg; intensityreg.registration_to_flow2d(result); from the registry, opsmatchreg.get("registration_to_flow2d"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Extracts the deformation field flow2d ((2,H,W) (dy, dx)) from a registration result table. → flow2d.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

向きは deformreg と同じ(動く画像の内容の前向き変位)。piv_flow_magnitude / piv_vorticity / flow_to_rgbimage など flow2d を受ける op へ繋ぐための口。

Args:

result: register_ecc / register_mi / register_ffd の表。

Returns:

(2, H, W) float64 の ndarray(写し)。

Raises:

ValueError: kind="registration" の表でない / 場の形が違う。
